thread:
sam: Quick thread 1: were launching a small PLG experiment next week. Scope: launch social post + inbound form tweak (credit-intent checkbox), 4 prompt templates in the post, and a follow-up webinar sequence. Need sync on copy, routing, and webinar CTA funnel.

toni (demand-gen): Love it. For the form: keep it minimal. Checkbox label: 'Send me starter credits' (unticked). If checked -> assign lead.score += 10 and tag credit_intent.

rav (devrel): For the templates bundle, I suggest 4 starter templates: 
- semantic-search (2-shot)
- triage-support (error -> solution)
- code-refactor helper
- email-gen for sales outreach
I can make shareable links for each so "Use template" preloads the playground.

sam: Webinar angle: 20min live demo (build a support bot + prompt templates). CTA flows:
- Post CTA -> webinar landing (option to tick credits)
- Landing -> if ticked, send immediate promo email with 500 credit code
- Post-webinar follow-up: templates + short checklist.

toni: Routing rules (HubSpot):
```
if (form.tag contains 'credit_intent' || coupon_redeemed == true) {
  lifecycle_stage = 'lead';
  assign_to = 'ae-self-serve';
} else if (page_engagement >= 2) {
  assign_to = 'marketing-nurture';
} else {
  add_to_list 'launch-drip-3';
}
```
Well capture utm_campaign=plg_launch_apr.

rav: Short copy suggestions for the post: 
1) "Ship features with smart prompts. Try 4 starter templates + 500 free credits."
2) "From idea to working assistant. Templates + credits to help you build."
3) "Lower latency, cheaper tokens. See how with our starter pack (webinar)."
I like 1 and 2. Toni: which performs better on social?

toni: Variant A (direct benefit) tends to beat aspirational A/Bs on LinkedIn. Use A for paid, B for organic. We'll run UTM variants.

sam: Measurement: landing CTR, form credit_checkbox rate, credit-redemption rate, activation (first successful gen within 48h), webinar attend->watch-time. Add a custom event 'template_clicked' so we can see template usage.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: 'Webinar dry-run' 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC. Attendees: @sam @toni @rav.

rav: Dev ask: need one API flag to seed credits on signup when coupon used. Will create PR with small endpoint. ETA 48h.

sam: OK. Action items: rav = template links + PR for credit seed; toni = paid/organic copy variants + UTM map; sam = landing + routing spec + dashboard events. Check-in tomorrow 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:
